text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm wondering if perhaps this was for the best.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's for the best... that we lost?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If I'd won, I might have been left
feeling
somewhat anticlimactic.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how much effort I put in
today—no
matter how I made the wind
blow—I couldn't seize
victory.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This proves with the utmost clarity that
today, we
took on a hurricane.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And the difficulty we faced in doing so
will propel
us to greater heights, and
help us evolve into
greater winds.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Losing is lame. It really does suck...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But that's not gonna stop us from
running again.
And as long as we can
run... we won't give up!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Someday, we'll become the winds
we aspire
to be.
